info.title: PayU Merchant Hosted — _payment
info.description:
OpenAPI **3.1** for PayU merchant-hosted **`POST /_payment`**.

The **`pg`** enum matches the payment rails reflected from the **Merchant Hosted Checkout** Postman collection
(cards, EMI, UPI, BNPL, net banking as **NB**, and the collection’s wallet sample which used **`pg=UPI`**).
Use **`bankcode`** and checkout APIs per your PayU **Key Account Manager (KAM)** for wallet-specific codes.

Hash rules and response verification: [merchant-hosted checkout](https://docs.payu.in/docs/custom-checkout-merchant-hosted).

post.description:
`application/x-www-form-urlencoded` POST to **`/_payment`**.

Set **`pg`** to the payment rail and **`bankcode`** to the PayU code for that instrument (see **`PaymentGateway`** enum and property descriptions).

* **Cards** — include **`ccnum`**, **`ccexpmon`**, **`ccexpyr`**, **`ccvv`**, **`ccname`** when collecting card on your site (**`pg`** **CC** or **DC**).
* **UPI** — include **`vpa`** when collecting UPI on your site (**`pg`** **UPI**, typically **`bankcode`** **UPI** per Postman sample).
* **EMI / BNPL / net banking** — use EMI/BNPL/net-banking **`bankcode`** values from PayU docs, **`get_checkout_details`**, or your **KAM** (Postman-style examples: **EMIA3** + **EMI**, **LAZYPAY** + **BNPL**, **TESTPGNB** + **NB**).

Build **`hash`** on your server per PayU rules for the fields you post.

upiFromPostman.summary: UPI — pg and bankcode UPI + vpa (Postman collection pattern)

netBankingFromPostman.summary: Net Banking — NB + TESTPGNB (Postman collection pattern; pg expressed here as NB)

emiFromPostman.summary: EMI — pg EMI + bankcode EMIA3 + card fields (Postman collection pattern)

bnplFromPostman.summary: BNPL — pg BNPL + bankcode LAZYPAY (Postman collection pattern)

200.description:
May return HTML or a **query-string style** body (e.g. `mihpayid=…&status=success&…`) depending on integration.
Verify **`hash`** on return using PayU’s post-response hash rules.

successQueryString.summary: Example success postback (truncated; from PayU card-flow docs)

302.description: Redirect to issuer / ACS / bank or merchant **surl** / **furl** (typical browser flow).

PaymentGateway.description:
Payment gateway (**`pg`**) — closed enum matching the **Merchant Hosted Checkout** Postman collection’s `_payment` samples.

| `pg` | Postman folder / use |
|------|----------------------|
| **CC** | Cards — credit card (**default** in PayU card docs if omitted) |
| **DC** | Cards — debit card (same collection variables; use with debit **bankcode**) |
| **EMI** | EMI — card instalment |
| **UPI** | UPI (and the collection’s **Wallets** sample, which used **`pg=UPI`**) |
| **BNPL** | BNPL (e.g. **LAZYPAY** **bankcode** in Postman) |
| **NB** | Net Banking (**TESTPGNB** **bankcode** in Postman sandbox sample; production **bankcode** from **`getNetBankingStatus`** / PayU docs) |

Confirm live **`pg`/`bankcode`** pairs with PayU docs or your **KAM**.

MerchantHostedPaymentForm.description:
Merchant-hosted **`_payment`** form. **Always required:** `key`, `txnid`, `amount`, `productinfo`, `firstname`, `email`, `phone`, `surl`, `furl`, `hash`, `pg`, `bankcode`.

**Conditional (per `pg` / instrument):** send **`ccnum`**, **`ccexpmon`**, **`ccexpyr`**, **`ccvv`**, **`ccname`** for card and EMI card flows; send **`vpa`** for UPI.

**Note:** Some PayU tables place name-on-card wording beside **`ccvv`**; CVV belongs in **`ccvv`**, cardholder name in **`ccname`**.

key.description: Unique merchant key issued by PayU for your account (`varchar`).

txnid.description:
Transaction ID (order id) generated at your end; used to track the order.
Must be **unique** for each new attempt — reusing an id that already succeeded returns a duplicate order id error.

amount.description:
Payment amount for the transaction (post as a decimal string; treat numerically as float at integration time).

* May be **0 INR** for some net-banking penny flows or **≥ 1 INR** for cards and UPI in penny use cases (per PayU).
* First-instalment behaviour applies only to selected flows (see PayU full docs).

email.description: Customer email (`varchar`, max 50). Use a valid value — used in fraud/chargeback context and some issuer MIS.

phone.description: Customer phone (`varchar`, max 50). Use a valid value — used in fraud/chargeback context and some issuer MIS.

surl.description: Success URL — PayU redirects here when the transaction succeeds.

furl.description: Failure URL — PayU redirects here when the transaction fails.

hash.description:
SHA512 hash so request data is not tampered between your site and PayU.

Classic-style formula (when applicable):  
`SHA512(key|txnid|amount|productinfo|firstname|email|udf1|udf2|udf3|udf4|udf5|||si_details|SALT)`.

Newer `_payment` versions may require an extended pipe sequence (including **`phone`** and further fields) per PayU documentation.

bankcode.description:
PayU code for the payment option. Must align with **`pg`** (Postman-style examples: **CC**+**CC**, **UPI**+**UPI**,
**EMI**+**EMIA3**, **BNPL**+**LAZYPAY**, **NB**+**TESTPGNB**). Card network codes: see PayU **Card number formats**
and **Card type codes and supported banks**. Wallet/BNPL codes may come from **`get_checkout_details`** or your **KAM**.

ccnum.description: **Cards / EMI:** card number — typically **13–19** digits (15 for AMEX, 13–19 for Maestro). Validate with **Luhn**.

ccvv.description: Cards / EMI: card security code (CVV). Name on card belongs in ccname, not ccvv.

ccexpmon.description: **Cards / EMI:** expiry **month** as **two digits** (`MM`). Months 1–9 as `01`…`09`; 10–12 as `10`, `11`, `12`.

ccexpyr.description: Cards / EMI: expiry year (four digits in Postman samples; follow PayU field rules for your integration).

ccname.description: Cards / EMI: name on card as entered by the customer.

vpa.description: UPI: virtual payment address (VPA) collected on your site.
